# asc_file_storage_access (Resource)

Grants a workload NFS access to a file storage in the DSPC platform. The backend resolves the workload's network CIDR and updates the NFS export configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_file_storage" "example" {
  name = "my-file-storage"
  size = "100Gi"
}

resource "asc_virtual_machine" "example" {
  name   = "my-vm"
  sku_id = "standard-2cpu-4gb"
}

resource "asc_file_storage_access" "example" {
  file_storage_name = asc_file_storage.example.name
  target_type       = "VirtualMachine"
  target_name       = asc_virtual_machine.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_storage_name` (String) Name of the file storage to grant access to.
- `target_name` (String) Name of the workload to grant access to.
- `target_type` (String) Type of the workload to grant access to. Valid values: VirtualMachine, Container.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this access entry ({file_storage_name}:{target_type}:{target_name}).
